_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. `Puzzle3dMutation` is a semio-NATIVE vocabulary carried in `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio`, so no oracle is registered and the decision below records what stands in for one.

oracles.rationale: A second implementation of the `s.puzzle.3d` scene document and its thirty-five typed mutations, in Python, at `../../../../../🧪️tests/mutate-puzzle-3d-1/🐍️component.py`. Written from `../🧬️schema/📸️snapshot/🔣️component.json` (the seven members), rules 2, 4 and 7 of `.🧬semio/🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️12/SEMANTIC-MUTATIONS-OVERHAUL/📓️derivation-rules.md`, and the thirty-five committed `(before, mutation, diff, outcome, after)` quintets — which are the only statement of three things: that a vortex list is INSIDE the object, so removing a vortex is an object mutation that CASCADES into the attractions addressed to it; that deleting an object severs every attraction naming any of its vortices; and that `scale` is a union, `scale-object` writing a per-axis triple over a uniform scalar while `scale-target-volume` writes a uniform scalar over a per-axis triple. It imports nothing from this repository and transliterates none of its Rust. This registration SUPERSEDES the `puzzle-3d-mutation-semantics` no-oracle decision, whose argument was refuted in this same wave by `mutate-fem3d-1` and `mutate-gisterrain-1`, which took Python second implementations over this same carrier. A THIRD-PARTY library was declined, not merely absent: glTF, USD and IFC all model a scene graph of transforms and none of them can express a joint whose two endpoints are named ports owned by two nodes and addressed as `"<objectId>:<vortexId>"`, let alone read this carrier. THE REFERENCE REFUSES THREE OF THE SEVENTY-ONE SCENARIOS BY CLAUSE, and says so in role: `replace-object-vortex` in both roles, whose single committed vector supplies a genuinely different vortex yet declares `mutation.no-op` with an unchanged after-snapshot, so that at least three different rules produce the committed outcome and no committed document distinguishes them; and `inverse-replace-kind-catalogs`, where the vector installs a catalogue where none existed and nothing states whether the verb accepts a null argument. Its sibling `mutate-puzzle-2d-1` reports both gaps identically over `replace-node-handle`. A FINDING THE REFERENCE MADE WHILE BEING WRITTEN: this subset's `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/🔣️component.json` is not a mutation schema at all — it is titled `Puzzle3dMutation` but declares the SNAPSHOT's members, the pre-migration whole-snapshot-shaped generic schema that `s.architect.program`'s own mutation schema records itself as superseding, and it was never replaced here — so the verbs and their argument lists had to be read off the committed payloads instead. ONE CEILING ON WHAT THIS COMPARISON ESTABLISHES: the SUBJECT half does not run this subset's codec — `../../../../../🧪️tests/mutate-puzzle-3d-1/🦀️component.rs` links no plugin crate and replays the committed vectors — so today it establishes that an independent implementation of the specification computes the committed after-snapshots, not yet our codec against a second producer. A `puzzle3d_mutation_report_json` bridge beside the mutation enum closes it; it is not added here for two reasons, and neither is that the verb is hard: it is PRODUCTION code in a crate this test-side pass deliberately does not touch, and it could not be verified end to end today anyway. `parity` was not measured for any case in this pass: the single-case probe `parity exhaustive --owner 🗒️note --case mutate-note-1` was killed at the runner's OWN 900 s per-case budget while still COMPILING the generated subject host — the runner's message names the cause, shared cargo target-dir lock contention from a concurrent session — and then threw `spawnSync cargo ETIMEDOUT` out of `runProbe` with no summary line at all. `📓️w14-final-audit.md` §5.3 measured the underlying blocker one day earlier (`unresolved import component::component_persistent_local` in `semio-framework-plugin`, which sits in every generated host's dependency graph); this pass did NOT re-verify whether that is still the state, and says so rather than repeating it as fact. This subset's own plugin crate compiles clean at `cargo check --lib`. This case also reads no real-world artifact: all 175 of its fixtures are handcrafted specification vectors. `package` is deliberately empty: the implementation needs no distribution, so this entry contributes nothing to `🔒️dependencies.json`.
